about: Sentences for End Marks, written for this app at about a 2nd to 3rd grade reading level. sentences: one sentence without its end mark, the one mark that fits (. telling, ? asking, ! strong feeling), and why. runs: three short sentences that are shown stuck together in lowercase; only one way to split them makes sense. lists: sentences with a list of three things and its two commas, shown without the commas at level 3. Characters are made up.
